rv.q: HEDDA GABLER at the National Theatre is an unforgettable production that will hopefully be seen by many young theatre makers inspiring them to create bold and radical work...
Ruth Wilson towers over this performance, joining the lengthy ranks of female performers who have excelled in 2016.

Why doesn't Hedda Gabler make more of herself? His is a clinical evaluation of a difficult play. Though it brings the action into the present, this isn't just an update of Ibsen, or one that finds Hedda as she exists in our world.
